fault: A selected microservice depends on a Spa_Package whose own build script emits no dist/, so the package is staged into the Image_Tree with no compiled output.

partition.justification: An npm clean install over this workspace succeeds — a Spa_Package whose build emits nothing is no install error — while the image build stages the Spa_Package as a Required_Dependency and its build-output assertion reports the absent dist over the installed tree. The Spa_Package is built by its own npm run build (never a tsc --build root), so the tsc pass over the other roots succeeds and only the build-output assertion fires.
